title: Organization MCP servers and skills
summary: Owners and maintainers set up MCP servers and skills for the organization on the site, and every member gets them in the app on top of their own.
usage: On the site, open the organization and use the MCP servers and Skills tabs: add a server with the form or by pasting mcpServers JSON, or paste a SKILL.md, and turn each one on or off. Only owners and maintainers see the servers on the site, since they may hold tokens. Changes arrive at the next sync. In the app, they're listed read-only under MCP and Skills in the organization's side menu; owners and maintainers get a button to edit them on the site.
